findings.message: Entry param page (filter:listaAvisos) had no state; added public state `page` (number | null, persisted) that records the page the person went to with a pager and feeds carregarMeusAvisos.

Entry param avisoId (filter:detalheAviso) had no state; it is only read as a fallback id for the initial selection when avisoVencimentoId is absent, and abrirAviso takes the id as argument. It is not persisted separately.
Entry param responsavelId comes from the session per the route comment: it is never read from URL/localStorage and is sent as '' (the backend fills it); no state was added.
No state held the page filter of the list (entry param page); added the persisted state 'page'.
Added the status and error states of the page and of each request (pageStatus, carregarMeusAvisosStatus/Error, abrirAvisoStatus/Error).
public page is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
